race.description: Scaada Environmental Dual Choice Plate Hcp (Bm84)
race.comment: KEEP YOUR COOL (3) comes here second up off a solid return at Mornington in similar company, just held up at a crucial stage when working home into fourth. Would have preferred this to be 1400m but she'll strip fitter and her best form last campaign goes close. CELSIUS STAR (1) just found one better first up in the Apache Cat Classic at Cranbourne which is strong form. Fitter for that and gets every hope up on the speed. RUE DE ROYALE (4) didn't fire on the heavy track at Flemington first up. Have to forgive that, he can bounce back from an ideal gate. IMMORTAL STAR (5) can run well fresh as can EVERAIN (8) who boasts a strong winning record.
